articles.summary: BOSTON, Feb. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bicara Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: BCAX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to bringing transformative bifunctional therapies to patients with solid tumors, today announced the closing of its underwritten public offering of 8,581,250
articles.title: Bicara Therapeutics Announces Closing of Oversubscribed Public Offering and Full Exercise of Underwriters’ Option to Purchase Additional Shares
